To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the teacher training course on corpora in language teaching is effective in terms of raising students' interest in the use of corporal data in language education, but it needs to be extended to cover the whole range of applications of corpora and corpus based tools in language education.

the course was generally successful in terms of its aims, but it is too short to encourage the participants to use corpora on a regular basis in the future; and the participants would benefit from more time to gain experience in corpus analysis and from further teacher training on the applications of corporas in language teaching.
the course was generally well received by the students but they needed more time and more guidance in order to be able to use corpora effectively in language education.

the following questions: What are the main objectives of the teacher training course on corpus use in language education? What are the students' attitudes to the course? the effectiveness of the course and the students’ perception of the benefits of the course in the context of their future work as teachers.
the effectiveness of teacher training in corpus use.

the teacher training course presented in this paper is a good start for future teachers, yet it needs to be followed by more advanced courses and workshops to make a real change in the way language teachers use corpora.
the course was not sufficient to make the students use corpora in language teaching. However, it may be a step in that direction.
the course has not been a failure but it has not been a success either.

we are not yet there, but we are moving in the right direction.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of corporal in language education should be a mandatory element of teacher training courses.

teacher trainees need to be introduced to corpora and their use in language education at the early stage of their education and they should be encouraged to use them in their future teaching practice.
teacher training in the field of corpus linguistics is an area that deserves much more attention from teacher trainers and teacher educators.
